legacyEvidencePolicy: Reports were used only to seed hypotheses and identify invalid assumptions; their inspected forward periods were not reused as holdout.
knownLimitations: The evaluator does not yet apply broker-specific minimum deal size, minimum stop distance, gap/slippage stress, financing, or guaranteed-stop premiums.
Repeated search iterations select against the development validation fold; only the external human-controlled locked test can provide a fresh confirmation.
Volume in broker candles is not a historical client-position series. flowImbalance and candleImbalance are explicitly labelled price/volume proxies, not actual buyer/seller counts.
Session windows are fixed UTC approximations and do not yet shift with London/New York daylight-saving transitions.
